items.title: Label the portal
items.body:
Rick: Morty, label the portal. Last time we came back with three microphones and no pants.
Morty: I labeled it "probably home," Rick!

items.title: Press record
items.body:
Rick: Press record, Morty. Genius is temporary. Audio files are forever.
Morty: That is a really uncomfortable storage policy, Rick.

items.title: Local universe
items.body:
Morty: So my voice stays on this computer?
Rick: Yes, Morty. One universe at a time.

items.title: The transcript dimension
items.body:
Rick: I turned sound into words, Morty. Try to act impressed.
Morty: The toaster did that yesterday, Rick. It said "help."

items.title: Speaker detection
items.body:
Morty: Rick, it says there are three speakers. There are only two of us.
Rick: Then stop giving the houseplant a microphone, Morty.

items.title: A very normal meeting
items.body:
Rick: Just a normal meeting, Morty. Agenda, notes, tiny dimensional breach.
Morty: Why is "tiny dimensional breach" a recurring agenda item?

items.title: One more take
items.body:
Morty: Can we do another take, Rick?
Rick: Sure. In the next universe, maybe you finish the sentence.

items.title: Interdimensional punctuation
items.body:
Rick: Commas are tiny portals, Morty. Put one in the wrong place and the whole sentence changes planets.
Morty: I just wanted to say hello, Rick.

items.title: Noise cancellation
items.body:
Morty: Can it remove background noise?
Rick: Yes. Unfortunately, your opinions are technically foreground noise.

items.title: Saved to reality
items.body:
Rick: Saved, Morty. Now even a collapsing timeline cannot claim you never said it.
Morty: Can we maybe collapse this particular timeline?

items.title: The short version
items.body:
Morty: Could you summarize that, Rick?
Rick: I was right. There. Saved you twelve pages.

items.title: Name your files
items.body:
Rick: Name your files, Morty. "Final-final-actually-final" is how civilizations fall.
Morty: What about "final-final-actually-final-two"?

items.title: Model warming up
items.body:
Morty: Why does the model need to warm up?
Rick: Because apparently I am the only genius here without a loading screen.

items.title: No cloud required
items.body:
Rick: No cloud required, Morty. Your secrets stay in this extremely suspicious little box.
Morty: You mean the Mac, Rick?
Rick: Do not ruin the atmosphere.

items.title: The library
items.body:
Morty: Rick, why are all your notes called "important"?
Rick: Because future me is going to have excellent search skills, Morty.

items.title: Speak naturally
items.body:
Rick: Speak naturally, Morty. The machine understands hesitation.
Morty: Uh, um, I, uh—
Rick: Not a full autobiography of hesitation.

items.title: Export destination
items.body:
Morty: Where should I export this, Rick?
Rick: Somewhere with a folder structure. We are monsters, not animals.

items.title: A quiet moment
items.body:
Rick: Listen to that, Morty. Silence. The only meeting participant with useful input.
Morty: It just asked to be made host, Rick.
